title: design-kb: gate definitions
description: The gate inventory in machine form. Session 1 fixes the SHAPE; Session 2's cluster formalisation supplies authoritative content. Includes the context-facet gate (hard-stop, top of every course conversation) and S1-D2/D3 source-consultation triggers.

kind.description: Gate realignment A2 (gate-redesign-2026-10-06.md): who acts. `human` = AI asks, person answers. `agent+human` = agent generates, person resolves (choose/amend/confirm; regenerate+steer always available). `auto` = reserved placeholder, auto-passes with a default, no human input in tier-1. No pure-`agent` gate in tier-1.

response.description: A2: how a human resolves this gate. Present on `human` and `agent+human` gates; absent on `auto`.

destination.description: Where the answer lands in the course-design answer-sheet.

generation.description: A2: what the agent produces. Present on `agent+human` gates. `sources`/`parameters` absorb the old sourceConsultation intent; `produces` points at this gate's decidedValueShape.

reserved.description: A4/A8: true marks a reserved placeholder gate that auto-passes with a default now and is defined in a later pass (e.g. the CXS context slots, cxp-03 exemplar-programmes).

id.description: Phase-prefixed slug form under the 2026-10-07 gate realignment (gate-redesign-2026-10-06.md): one of the six phase prefixes onb|cxs|crs|les|wra|cxp, a two-digit sequence, an underscore, and a kebab slug (e.g. crs-02_thematic-scope, onb-01_theme-preset). The old bare `gates/X` and ctx-/act- forms are retired by Round C.

cluster.description: Conversational movement, e.g. identity, architecture, furniture (phase A three-cluster structure).

sequence.description: RJ-0059: this gate's position in the course-design conversation's run order, lowest first. The sole source of order; a command reads this field through the shared gate-order tool rather than keeping its own list.

repeatsPer.description: RJ-0059: a gate decided more than once per course. 'lesson' (LES, les-01_lesson-proposal) runs once per lesson, keyed <slug>-<lessonKey>-les-01. 'context-pack' (CXP per-pack gates cxp-01_subject, cxp-02_qualifiers, cxp-04_context-generation; gate-redesign-2026-10-06.md, 8 Oct 2026, D1) runs once per context pack, keyed <slug>-<subject>-<phase-nn>. cxp-03_exemplar-programmes is subject-independent and stays once-per-course, so carries no repeatsPer.

procedureFlags.description: RJ-0059: per-gate procedure steps that gate.md's own step text makes conditional on the gate, read by the shared gate-order tool instead of gate.md keeping its own list.

varietyView.description: gate.md step 3: list every pattern id and realisation already recorded at the same gate for every other lesson in this course, present only on B2, B3, B4, B5, S1.

candidates.description: gate.md step 4: activity-gate slot choices, present only on B2, B3, B4, B5, S1, W1.

sourceConsultation.description: S1-D2/D3/D8: which facet presences oblige knowledge-store lookup before this gate's proposal. Authority levels map to stores: sector+subject -> source-kb (external published); institutional+module -> institutional-kb (institution-supplied, multi-institution).

onNoMatch.description: Behaviour when no source matches — DESIGN HELD FOR SESSION 3; record intent only.

consequenceNote.description: What this gate constrains downstream; only where it earns its place.

reachabilityFacet.description: RULED 17 Sep 2026 (Abbott, superseding PR-S-27's prose-only position): optional. Present means this gate is reached only when the named facet is present in the facet set CTX closed (S1-D4); absent means always reached, true of all 18 gates that predate gates/EXM. Governs whether the gate is reached, not its hardness once reached. Same facet vocabulary as sourceConsultation.triggeringFacets — no separate vocabulary. Deliberately a single facet-presence test: no operators, negation, or multiple clauses; a condition language is out of scope until something other than EXM needs one.

dependsOn.description: AMENDMENT (dimension 5, S2, 26 Aug 2026): static propagation edges - the sweep net's sole authority for WHO a reopen sweep visits. Class-level, conservative, deliberately over-inclusive; absence of a manifest citation never exempts a record from the sweep. dependencyClass IS the default verdict: constitutive->invalidate, substantive->flag-for-review, nominal->stand-with-warning. Grain is the edge, not the gate (B4-on-B2 constitutive, B4-on-A2 substantive). A discovered missing edge is a design-kb bug warranting its own records entry.

propagationScope.description: AMENDMENT (dimension 5, S2, 26 Aug 2026): universal = this gate grounds the entire conversation (CTX, per S1-D4); it carries NO dependsOn edges and no static classes - sweep verdicts are proposed per event via the change-kind tracer on the sourceConsultation facet->store mapping read consultation-out. Absent = listed.

decidedValueShape.description: LCR-1 (docs/project/open-decisions.md, Prompt 143): a Draft-07 JSON Schema fragment that a closed record's decidedValue must validate against, applied by validate-design-schemas.py --course-design. Present only on gates whose decidedValue carries fields a lesson check reads (A3, B1, B2, B4 at landing). Absent means no shape is enforced beyond the record's own schema. Keyed to the gate's own id (bare for course-level gates, matched by suffix for slug-prefixed per-lesson gates per GF-1) rather than expressed as a schema conditional in course-design.schema.json, because a record's own subschema there has no sibling visibility of its parent gateId, and GF-1's slug-prefixed per-lesson form (gates/<slug>-L<NN>-B<n>) cannot be matched by const in any case.
